study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual-level deviations from normative brain morphology in violence, psychosis, and psychopathy

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TOP, STROKEMRI, uTOP, and sTOP provided the study participants; pretrained normative models were trained on a large multi-site dataset (58,835 individuals from 82 sites).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Participants ... were recruited from the Oslo area as part of four studies: the Thematically Organized Psychosis study (TOP) [30], the STROKEMRI study [31], The Youth-TOP study (uTOP) [32], and The Forensic Psychiatry study (sTOP) [33]." "models were trained using data of 58835 individuals aged 2 -100 from 82 sites."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: A separate calibration set of 998 healthy controls was used to fine-tune model parameters for applying the pretrained normative models to the study data.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Participants ... were recruited from the Oslo area as part of four studies: the Thematically Organized Psychosis study (TOP) [30], the STROKEMRI study [31], The Youth-TOP study (uTOP) [32], and The Forensic Psychiatry study (sTOP) [33]. 998 healthy controls (390 male/608 female) were used as a calibration set to adjust the model to our data [20]." "models were trained using data of 58835 individuals aged 2 -100 from 82 sites."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A separate unmatched calibration set of 998 healthy controls was used to fine-tune model parameters for application to unseen sites.
